newsitem.title: UK: BFI up seven as Panamaxes remain firm.
newsitem.headline: BFI up seven as Panamaxes remain firm.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) was up seven points on Wednesday to 1,381 points. as solid demand for Panamaxes continued.
The 1984-built Delphic Pride 64,000 dwt was understood fixed on subjects by NSS delivery prompt North Spain trip via US Gulf with coal to Japan at $14,000 daily.
The rate of $24.25 no combo has been repeated for 54,000 heavy grain US Gulf to Japan, this time by Cargill with Astra Guillermo for July 18/25.

The firm Panamax market in South America affected rates from the Indian Ocean area. Panocean booked Oinoussian Father 64,000 dwt on subjects delivery Bin Qasim mid July for three to five months at close to $10,000 daily.
At 1200 GMT BIFFEX was 16 to 10 points higher and turnover was 64 lots.
